scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.check: pnpm ts-check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter frontend dev" "pnpm --filter backend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test:run && pnpm --filter backend test:run
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter frontend test" "pnpm --filter backend test"
scripts.ts-check: pnpm --filter frontend ts-check && pnpm --filter backend ts-check
